description: Describes validation requirements for each dataset. Specifies which validation checks must be applied when data is collected or updated. Configuration only — no validation engine is implemented.

railway_zones.notes: Zone codes must be unique. All required fields must be present.

railway_divisions.notes: Division codes must be unique. Each division must reference a valid zone.

station_codes.notes: Station codes must be unique. Each station code must reference a valid division.

station_master.notes: Station codes must be unique. Coordinates must be valid lat/lon values. Each record must reference a valid station code.

train_master.notes: Train numbers must be unique. All required fields must be present.

station_categories.notes: Category codes must be unique. All required fields must be present.

station_status.notes: Each status record must reference a valid station code. Status values must conform to allowed formats.

notes: Validation policy registry. Describes what validation checks must be applied to each dataset. No validation engine is implemented. These policies will be consumed by future validation phases.
